notes: The City Council officially consists of 7 seats. Currently, only 6 members are listed on the official roster because Karen Dallman was appointed Mayor in April 2026, leaving her former council seat vacant. Pamela Smith on seat_1 (short 2025-07 -> 2026 term) is likely the appointee filling that gap, with the August 2026 primary set to formalize this. The primary election on August 4, 2026 will elect one Mayor and two full-term Council Members, plus one two-year-term Council Member.

meeting_patterns.location: City Council Chambers, 1255 Marina Boulevard, Bullhead City, AZ 86442
meeting_patterns.notes: 57 Regular Meeting instances over 28 months; 54 of 57 fit the 1st + 3rd Tuesday cadence at 5:30 PM (high confidence). 3 outliers (one Wed, one 5th Tue, one Mon-shift) appear to be holiday reschedules. Time format quirk: parser stores meeting_time without AM/PM marker; civic context makes 05:30 = 5:30 PM. Times shifted from 4:30 PM (early 2024) to 5:30 PM (mid-2024 onward); modal is 5:30 PM. Parser also captures Special Meetings, Executive Sessions, Work Sessions, and Budget Work Sessions for the same body — those are off-cadence and excluded from the recurring pattern. Other Bullhead bodies (Planning Commission, P&Z) are NOT in the scrape; parser-coverage gap to fill via WebFetch fallback in a follow-up.

notebooklm_persona_preamble: The city of Bullhead City is located in Mohave County, Arizona. The Bullhead City Council has 7 voting seats elected at-large; one council seat is currently vacant pending the August 2026 election. The current members are: Mayor Karen Dallman, Vice Mayor Dan Alfonzo, and Council Members Pamela Smith, Jason Newlin, Eugene O'Neill, and Tami Ring. When transcribing or attributing quotes, use these exact spellings.
